title: Giving it away in chat
line: You give away the transformation or the solution free in the chat … you’re not being able to build a profitable coaching business.
visual: White kicker GIVING IT ALL AWAY, yellow FREE IN CHAT. Faint CHAT lettering sits behind the hair.
motion: Headline is present at frame one. Blue dry-brush underline draws on “free” at 7.44s. Punch on “chat” at 8.07s; release before the series tile.
sfx: Short brush sweep at 7.44s; soft impact at 8.07s.

title: Free solutions in the chat
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series.
visual: Approved title in regular, cursive and bold type on one optical left edge. Blue For free. is followed closely by a larger Right in the chat. in regular type, forming one closing thought. Clear series header above.
motion: The full problem statement and series header enter together at 11.91s and hold for thumbnail selection. Wipe upward from 13.51s.
hero: The problem: giving away the solution for free when a client messages
camera: Full-page title card; no footage treatment.
sfx: One quiet paper sweep on exit.

title: The recurring promise
line: What it takes to build a ₹1 crore coaching business.
visual: The familiar ₹1 CRORE headline and white italic coaching business line.
motion: Kicker follows the sentence. ₹1 CRORE lands at 15.38s; coaching business follows at 15.75s. Exit before the next sentence.

title: The instant answer
line: He’s … asking you a question on the chat … so you go ahead and give the solution right away in the chat.
visual: Two editorial dialogue rows: CLIENT / A QUESTION and YOU / THE SOLUTION. A small serif note says right away. No chat-app mockup.
motion: Client row appears on “question” at 20.86s. The second row stays hidden until “solution” at 26.60s; it snaps into place, showing how quickly the expert replies.
sfx: One light tick per row; brief thread-pull sound on the answer.

title: Two missing stitches
line: There are two things which is happening.
visual: A hand-drawn seam has two missing stitches, numbered 01 and 02. The two labels are withheld until each is explained.
motion: Thread draws from left to right on “two things” at 34.42s and stalls at the first opening. Numbers land with two quiet ticks. This is the construction that returns completed.

title: The diagnosis stops short
line: You are not being able to identify the problem to the core. You might not be able to give away the transformation in the chat.
visual: A full-page cutaway: a probe reaches the surface question, while the tangled core stays below it, untouched. Blue question mark; no yellow.
motion: Page slides up. Probe descends on “identify” at 38.19s, stops at the surface, and exposes the deeper knot on “core” at 39.45s. Hold the unresolved distance; wipe out at 42.54s.
camera: Full-screen cutaway for 5.3s; reset framing underneath.
sfx: Soft page sweep, then a dry stop; let the explanation breathe.

title: Advice never becomes action
line: Number two, the action … is not being implemented at a scale or at a level that it should be.
visual: The same seam returns. Advice sits on one side and ACTION IN LIFE on the other. The second missing stitch prevents the thread from carrying through.
motion: 02 enters on “number two” at 43.05s. Thread pulls toward the gap on “action” at 44.43s, then falls slack on “not … implemented” at 47.22–47.62s. No resolved yellow state yet.
sfx: A gentle thread pull, then silence when it slackens.

title: The result is missing
line: He’s not able to experience the kind of transformation or overcome the problem.
visual: A spare white statement: NO TRANSFORMATION. The blue unfinished underline stops short. The graphics make space for your delivery.
motion: “NO” lands with “not” at 52.34s; TRANSFORMATION enters at 53.69s. The underline cannot finish. Clear before the authority consequence.
sfx: One muted thud; no celebratory sound.

title: Authority is not established
line: You are not perceived as an authority, as a person who can solve that problem for him.
visual: WHO CAN SOLVE THIS? above a white italic authority? The question mark remains blue; faint PROOF behind the head.
motion: Question arrives on “not perceived” at 56.72s; authority enters at 57.70s. The question mark holds unresolved. Exit at 61.02s for a speaker-only breath.
camera: 1.06× hold; eye contact carries this beat.
sfx: Single quiet tick; leave the rest dry.

title: Build a profitable business
line: You will end up building a charity business instead of building a profitable coaching business.
visual: Two structured rows. CHARITY BUSINESS is crossed out; PROFITABLE COACHING is the one yellow destination. It is presented as your spoken business contrast.
motion: First row enters on “charity” at 66.80s. Blue brush crosses it on “instead” at 67.83s. Yellow row lands on “profitable” at 68.71s.
sfx: Brush stroke at 67.83s; soft impact at 68.71s.

title: The complete customer journey
line: Put them through your customer journey and help them walk through the process of transformation … you’ve designed.
visual: The earlier seam returns in the same position. Both gaps are stitched closed. UNDERSTAND → IMPLEMENT → TRANSFORM becomes one continuous thread; only the outcome turns yellow.
motion: The structure returns on “customer journey” at 72.60s. Thread closes both gaps on “walk through” at 74.46s, then the final stitch and TRANSFORM resolve yellow on “transformation” at 76.09s.
hero: Final stitch and TRANSFORM as one outcome
camera: Release to 1.00× for the diagram; tiny settle on the payoff.
sfx: Two gentle stitch clicks; warm, restrained resolve at 76.09s.

title: Design the coaching experience
line: If you’re … wanting to design the coaching experience for your clients … so that you don’t give away all the transformation or all the solutions for free in the chat…
visual: White DESIGN THE above yellow italic coaching experience. Faint PROCESS behind the speaker links the offer to the resolved journey.
motion: DESIGN THE enters at 80.58s. The serif payoff follows “coaching experience” at 81.17s. Hold through the invitation, then clear for the actual comment keyword.
sfx: Subtle sweep into the serif phrase.

title: Comment TRANSFORM
line: Comment TRANSFORM, and I’ll help you out for free.
visual: Nine yellow keycaps spell TRANSFORM on one line. White italic promise: & I’ll help you out, for free.
motion: COMMENT enters on “comment” at 88.36s; TRANSFORM keys land in three quick groups from 89.08s. The help promise appears on “help” at 90.14s and holds to the final frame. Timings refined with a separate word-level pass over the closing audio.
sfx: Three soft key pops, 0.12s apart; no long tail.
